items.content:
Hey Appraiser,

NTE will undergo maintenance on September 30 from 06:00 to 11:00 (UTC+8). Once it's done, the all-new Version 1.4 "For Whom the Verses Mourn" will go live!

▶Check out NTE Version 1.4 PV on YouTube:

Along with new content and events, this update is packed with rewards from start to finish. Here's what's in store:

\

1. "Circle Gifts" Login Event

Duration: September 30 (after update) – November 11, 05:59 (UTC+8)

Details: Log in for a total of 7 days to earn Solid Dice x10.

2.Pukaland Fest Special Gift Pack

After the version update on September 30, 2026 (UTC+8), claim Solid Dice x10 and the "Like Clockwork" avatar frame from your mail.

After the second update on October 21, 2026 (UTC+8), claim Akane's "House Special" outfit and Fons x2,000,000 from your mail.

Eligibility: Appraisers who have created a character and unlocked the Mail feature before Version 1.4 ends.

3.City Tycoon: "Puka Membership Program"

Available: After the Version 1.4 update

Details: Once the "Puka Membership Program" opens, complete its quest series and raise your Sweetdream Level to unlock "Puka Boot Camp", "Drone Follow-Cam", Sakiri's new outfit "Gingerbear Biscuit", Baicang's new outfit "Master Slacker", Haniel's new outfit "Classroom Hijinks", an S-Class Standard Character Selection Box, a "Puka Membership" S-Class Arc Selection Box, the accessories "Moonless Night" and "Grand Prize", the avatar frame "Cha-Ching!", the namecard "Fons Legend", the title "Puka Tycoon" and phone wallpaper "Making It Rain", the dice skins "Doooonut" and "Puka-Pukaboo", and more!

※ Open the "Puka Membership" S-Class Arc Selection Box to choose one of these Arcs: Reality Refuge, Youthful Fantasy, Good Boy's Grand Adventure, Camellia Society, Raging Flames, Blow up the Crowd, Tears Beneath the Mask, Eternal Waltz, or Song of the Whale.

\

1. New Character & Arc

● New Limited S-Class Character: Blackbird

Available: September 30 (after update) – October 21, 05:59 (UTC+8)

Unlock Requirement: Complete the main story quest "Prologue - A New Destination - Head to Eibon Antique Shop"

Board Details: The "Foretold Finale" Limited Board features S-class character Blackbird, alongside A-class characters Mint, Edgar, and Adler.

During the event, the "Foretold Finale" Limited Board features "The Harbinger" glider livery, the "Nightplume" Yesteryear bike livery, and Blackbird's "Rouge et Noir" outfit. The Divination Perks event runs alongside the board, so you can claim these rewards directly from the event page once you reach 50/120/200 cumulative rolls, or obtain them randomly through rolls before reaching these milestones.

*For full details, head to Scarborough Fair in-game.

● New Limited S-Class Arc: "Crime and Punishment"

Available: September 30 (after update) – October 21, 05:59 (UTC+8)

Unlock Requirement: Complete the main story quest "Prologue - A New Destination - Head to Eibon Antique Shop"

Research Guide: Spend Tri-Keys or Roostfeather Keys to participate in the "Roostfeather Special" Arc Research Program and obtain the limited S-Class Arc "Crime and Punishment". This Arc is currently only available through this program.

*For full details, head to Arc Shop › Arc Research Program in-game.

● Limited S-Class Character Lacrimosa Returns

Available: September 30 (after update) – October 21, 05:59 (UTC+8)

Unlock Requirement: Complete the main story quest "Prologue - A New Destination - Head to Eibon Antique Shop"

Board Details: The "Fading Reverie" Limited Board features S-class character Lacrimosa, alongside A-class characters Mint, Edgar, and Adler.

During the event, the "Fading Reverie" Limited Board features the "Tomato Duo" glider livery, the "Tomato Cruise" Regalia Pendragon livery, and Lacrimosa's "Gilded Rhapsody" outfit. Claim them from the Daydream Perks page by accumulating 50/120/200 rolls, or obtain them randomly through rolls before reaching these milestones.

※ Only rolls on the "Fading Reverie" Limited Board count toward Daydream Perks progress. Each board is tracked independently, and progress carries over between boards with the same name.

*For full details, head to Scarborough Fair in-game.

● Limited S-Class Arc "The Last Rose" Returns

Available: September 30 (after update) – October 21, 05:59 (UTC+8)

Unlock Requirement: Complete the main story quest "Prologue - A New Destination - Head to Eibon Antique Shop"

Research Guide: Spend Tri-Keys or Nocturne Keys to participate in the "Nocturne Special" Arc Research Program and obtain the limited S-Class Arc "The Last Rose". This Arc is currently only available through this program.

*For full details, head to Arc Shop › Arc Research Program in-game.

2. New Story

● New Main Story Episode: "The Witch"

A mysterious letter. A sinister ritual. A town shrouded in secrets...

Fear clouds eyes that should see clearly, and no fire can burn away the shadow of the curse.

In the lull between endless trials, the bewildered townsfolk whisper:

"Witch, witch, where are you?"

Available: After the Version 1.4 update

Unlock Requirement: Complete the main story episode "Fogden Game"

● City Hangouts

A new City Hangouts story featuring Blackbird

Available: After the Version 1.4 update

Unlock Requirement: Obtain Blackbird and reach the required Bond Level

● Home Time

A new Invitation mode featuring Blackbird.

Available: After the Version 1.4 update

Unlock Requirement: Obtain Blackbird and reach the required Bond Level

3. New Locations

● New Location: Pukaland

Where joy gathers, anything can happen.

Welcome to Pukaland! Make the most of everything it has to offer. Adventures, chance encounters, even the occasional unbelievable fairy tale: embrace them all and write your own story!

● New Location: St. Arbor

A town at the foot of the mountain, once a quiet place where people lived and worked in peace.

4. New Outfits & Accessories

● New Blackbird Outfit "Wandering Stars" Added to Shop

Discount Period: October 7, 06:30 – November 11, 05:59 (UTC+8)

Discount Price: Riftcrystal x2,680

Original Price: Riftcrystal x3,280 (18% off, limited time)

Available: October 7, 06:30 (UTC+8)

Shop Availability: Permanent

● New Blackbird Outfit "Rouge et Noir"

How to Get: While the "Foretold Finale" Limited Board is active, roll on the board and land on the matching tile to obtain the outfit, or claim it from the Divination Perks page once you've accumulated enough rolls.

● New Blackbird Outfit "Unfazed Denim"

How to Get: Unlocked after you obtain Blackbird and reach Bond Lvl 10 with her.

● New Outfits: Sakiri's "Gingerbear Biscuit", Baicang's "Master Slacker", and Haniel's "Classroom Hijinks"

How to Get: Unlock by reaching the required level in City Tycoon: "Puka Membership Program".

● New Accessories: "Tomorrow's Star", "Position Zero", and "Neon Nights"

Price: Fons x1,600,000

How to Get: Purchase in Mall › Fashion Shop.

● New Accessories: "Moonless Night" and "Grand Prize"

How to Get: Unlock by reaching the required level in City Tycoon: "Puka Membership Program".

● New Accessory: "Big Brains"

How to Get: Redeem at the Star Ticket Counter in Pukaland.

● New Accessory: "Knockingbird"

How to Get: Unlock by earning a specific achievement.

5. NTE × Porsche Collab Begins!

● New Mystery Box Event: "Born to Race"

Available: September 30 (after update) – November 11, 05:59 (UTC+8)

Details: Spend Fons or Annulith to open "Born to Race" Mystery Boxes. Your first box costs Fons x50,000 or Annulith x50, and the price climbs with each one after. There are 15 boxes in total, and opening all of them unlocks every reward in the pool.

Mystery Box Contents: "Born to Race" Mystery Boxes feature the brand-new Porsche collab vehicles "Porsche Taycan Turbo GT with Weissach Package" and "Porsche 911 Turbo (930)", Fabricated Dice, A Handwritten Letter, Fons, the limited avatar frame "Redline Rush", the exclusive namecard "Roar Recharged", and more.

※ Note: Vehicles obtained from Collab Mystery Boxes do not include a signature nameplate.

● "Everdriving" Mystery Boxes Return

Available: September 30 (after update) – November 11, 05:59 (UTC+8)

Details: Spend Fons or Annulith to open "Everdriving" Mystery Boxes. Your first box costs Fons x50,000 or Annulith x50, and the price climbs with each one after. There are 15 boxes in total, and opening all of them unlocks every reward in the pool.

Mystery Box Contents: "Everdriving" Mystery Boxes feature the Porsche collab vehicle "Porsche 918 Spyder", Esper Zero's limited collab outfit "Perfect Partners", Fabricated Dice x10, A Handwritten Letter x3, Fons x500,000, the limited avatar frame "Heartbeat Moment", the exclusive namecard "Trackside Shadow", and more.

※ Your previous "Everdriving" Mystery Box progress carries over, so you can pick up right where you left off.

※ Note: Vehicles obtained from Collab Mystery Boxes do not include a signature nameplate.

● "Porsche Club" Now Open

Appraisers, welcome to the "Porsche Club"!

After the update, owning any of the Porsche collab vehicles above unlocks the matching Club Perks:

"Porsche 918 Spyder": Unlocks "Power Boost", a modification for Porsche collab vehicles.

"Porsche 911 Turbo (930)": Unlocks "Salzburg", a classic livery for Porsche collab vehicles.

"Porsche Taycan Turbo GT with Weissach Package": Unlocks the Porsche collab furniture "Badge of Honor", the namecard "Horizon Spectre", the phone case "No Substitute", the phone wallpaper "Relentless Drive", and the title "Porsche Club".

6. New Events

● "Pukaland Travelogue" Limited-Time Event

Duration: September 30 (after update) – November 11, 05:59 (UTC+8)

Details: Welcome to Pukaland, where your magical journey begins! Collect Wonder Stamps and unlock your exclusive park memories. During the event, complete limited-time encounters to earn Annulith, Fabricated Dice, Floe Cinema Tickets, Elite Hunter Guides, Chaotic Dye, and more.

● "Terminal Depths" Limited-Time Event

Duration: September 30 (after update) – November 11, 05:59 (UTC+8)

Details: Dear passengers, we are now approaching ** Station. Clear stages during the event to earn the title "Off-Rail Operator", Annulith, Fons, Elite Hunter Guides, Chaotic Dye, and more.

● "Coal Lump's Treasure" Limited-Time Event

Duration: October 8, 10:00 – November 11, 05:59 (UTC+8)

Keep those grubby little paws off Coal Lump's treasures! Take part during the event to earn the event currency "Prism Drop", and reach the target high scores to unlock the titles "Sweet Benefactor" and "Bestie Supreme". You can also visit the event shop to exchange for Annulith, Floe Cinema Tickets, Fons, Elite Hunter Guides, Chaotic Dye, and more.

● "Stamina Recharge" Limited-Time Event

Duration: October 5, 05:00 – October 19, 04:59 (server time)

Details: During the event, spend City Stamina at 2x efficiency in "Hethereau Hobbies" activities.

● "Pixel Surge" Limited-Time Event

Duration: October 19, 05:00 – October 26, 04:59 (server time)

Details: During the event, spend Character Pixels in "Houdinii's Magic Stage", "Houdinii's Schemes", "Bubble Can Factory", and "Rabbit Hole" to receive double the rewards.

Each day, double rewards apply to up to 120 Character Pixels spent. Unused daily allowance carries over, up to a total cap of 840 Character Pixels for the whole event.

7. Other Content

● New Anomaly Commissions

Available after the version update on September 30 (UTC+8): "Night of the Last Bus", "Lilliput in the Looking Glass", and "Perfectly Ordinary Dreams"

Available after the second update on October 21 (UTC+8): "No Rest for the Cookies"

● Version 1.4 "Circle Bounty" Guide

Available: September 30 (after update) – November 10, 23:59 (UTC+8)

Requirement: Complete the Main Quest "Relax Time"

Details: During the event, complete Circle Quests to earn Experience Points and raise your Circle Bounty Rank, unlocking Fabricated Dice, Gold Carrota, De-noise Solution, A Handwritten Letter, Eternal Shell Song, Development EXP Selection Box I, Expansion Core, and more.

Purchase "Elite Hunter Supplies" to unlock additional rewards as you rank up, including Annulith x680, Solid Dice x4, Fabricated Dice x2, Arc-light Trove II x1, A Handwritten Letter x2, Fons x950,000, and more!

Purchase this season's "Honor Hunter Supplies" to get all the extra rewards listed above, plus instantly receive the "Pukaboo" avatar, the "Puka Adventure" avatar frame, the "Pukaland Journal" namecard, Fabricated Dice x5, A Handwritten Letter x1, and Fons x500,000!

※ Open Arc-light Trove II to choose one of the following: Fluff of Fearlessness, Fluff of Fleetness, Fluff of Finesse, Fluff of Ferocity, Fluff of Fortitude, or Fons x2,000,000.

● "Blackbird's Invitation" Web Event

Duration: September 30, 11:00 – November 11, 05:59 (UTC+8)

Details: During the event, share your personal invite link to bring new and returning Appraisers into the event. Each invite code can be linked to up to 20 new Appraiser accounts and 20 returning Appraiser accounts. Once linked, accounts cannot be unlinked.

Complete quests on the event page to earn Annulith or Divination Attempts. Spend Divination Attempts for a chance to win Solid Dice x10 and other rewards.

You can also enter the redeem code from the event page in-game to claim a limited avatar frame.

※ Rewards cannot be claimed after the event ends. Be sure to claim them in time.

\

◆ Add a new cosmetic system: Accessories

◆ Add multiplayer to "Volley Star"

◆ Add a follow-cam mode to "Photo Mode - Drone Mode"

◆ Add new collectible types to "Going, Going, Gone!", plus a new Auction Assistant: Blackbird

◆ Add "Sweetdream Charity Drive" to City Tycoon: donate specific items to directly boost your Fons progress

◆ Increase Fons accumulation speed in the original City Tycoon Program

◆ Increase Hunter Supplies level cap to Lvl 80 and boost rewards beyond Lvl 50

◆ Add a "Bulk Gift" button to the Bond interface, so you can quickly redeem or purchase gifts and max out Bond Levels

◆ Add "First Meeting Replay" to the Character interface: linger for a bit to play the character's unlock animation (enable it under Settings › Control › First Meeting Replay)

◆ Add friend recommendations to the Friends interface

◆ Move "Fighting with a Dragon" to Spinoffs

◆ Allow placing Figurines anywhere on your Property, or displaying them in a Figurine Cabinet.

◆ Add Bond quests for Blackbird

◆ Add Bond interactions for Blackbird: reach the required Bond Level to unlock her passenger seat ride-along.

◆ Add a combat tutorial for Blackbird

◆ Improve controller support for Linko's Life Skill

◆ Fix an issue where Lacrimosa's Awakening Effect "Morning Spell" did not take effect when a Redirect Skill was used to cast Linko's "Ultimate: Oversync"

◆ Fix an issue where switching to Zankou after Linko cast "Ultimate: Oversync" displayed Zankou's Ultimate cooldown incorrectly when "Ultimate: Inferno Flamenco" had full Ultimate Energy but was still on cooldown

◆ Fix an issue where Linko's "Basic Attack: Spectral Rush" could sometimes lose its target

◆ Fix incorrect damage calculation when Linko triggers a Synced Strike

◆ Fix an issue where Linko could sometimes clip through models during the Hug interaction

◆ Fix missing sound effects for Iroi's jump and landing roll

◆ Fix an issue where some character outfits were missing their Awakening Lvl 6 visual effects

◆ Fix an issue where the achievement "Pinky Promise" could not be completed

◆ Fix crashes that could occur in certain situations.

◆ Improve localization for several languages.

◆ Fix other known issues.

items.title: Neverness to Everness adds a theme park, a ghost bus, and more Porsche stuff September 30
‘Neverness to Everness’ Version 1.4 “For Whom the Verses Mourn” Launches 30 Sept.
items.summary: Developer Hotta World and publisher Perfect World will be launching Version 1.4, dubbed "For Whom the Verses Mourn", for their free-to-play supernatural
items.content:
Developer Hotta World and publisher Perfect World will be launching Version 1.4, dubbed “For Whom the Verses Mourn”, for their free-to-play supernatural urban open-world game ‘NTE: Neverness to Everness’ on 30 September across PC (Windows/macOS/Linux via Proton), PlayStation 5, and mobile platforms . The streets of Hethereau are getting busier, as two new Porsche vehicles hit the road and the gates to Pukaland finally open, turning the previously inaccessible theme park into a new area packed with attractions, discoveries and rewards. Version 1.4 also introduces new character Blackbird, a mysterious witch who can transform into a bird and fly through the open world, and a series of new supernatural mysteries for Neverness to Everness.

Players who have spent their time in Hethereau wondering what lies beyond the gates of Pukaland will finally get their answer on September 30. Version 1.4 transforms the familiar landmark into a fully explorable theme park with four distinct zones, packed with attractions that offer their own challenges.

Start on Puka Avenue with the Pendulum, Spinning Octopus and Drop Tower, where a button-input minigame challenges players to climb even higher. Venture deeper into the park to race through Cakehill’s Flora Maze before your stamina runs out, avoid lurking inhabitants in the Spooky Cookies haunted house, or ride a roller coaster through Lavaton’s volcanic landscape.

The Wonderlog tracks activities and rewards across the park, with Puka Stars earned at attractions exchangeable for souvenirs and other items. Familiar characters will also join in the festivities along the way.

And when night falls, players can gather around Pukatopia Castle to watch fireworks illuminate the sky. Just keep an eye out: even a day at the theme park can take an unexpected turn when anomalies are involved.

Just in time for spooky season, the enigmatic witch Blackbird joins NTE’s playable roster on 30 September, alongside the return of “Ketchup Demon” Lacrimosa. Blackbird’s tale begins with a mysterious plea for help that draws the usually homebound witch out into the unknown, leaving players to uncover who needs her help and where the journey will lead. Beyond her story, Blackbird offers a distinctive new way to explore the open world. She can transform into a bird and take to the skies, while character interactions allow her to hold hands with the protagonist and even take them flying. Away from battle, these moments reveal a different side to her, with three outfits offering even more ways to showcase her personality and style.

Version 1.4 will also bring new Anomaly Commissions to Hethereau, expanding the city’s collection of strange and supernatural encounters. Players may find themselves waiting for a Ghost Bus late at night, surrounded by some unusual passengers, or searching a dream for a hidden anomaly while trying to avoid the lurking monsters. Another investigation takes an unexpected turn when everyday objects suddenly become enormous.

These new commissions will become permanent additions to Hethereau, giving players even more mysteries to uncover as they explore the city.

The second NTE × Porsche collaboration shifts into gear with two new additions: the Porsche 911 Turbo (930) and the Porsche Taycan Turbo GT with Weissach Package. Whether behind the wheel of the iconic 911 Turbo or the cutting-edge Taycan Turbo GT, players can take their favourite onto the streets of Hethereau and make the journey between destinations part of the experience.

The Porsche 918 Spyder also makes its return, giving players who missed the first collaboration another chance to add it to their collection.

Version 1.4 also opens the doors to the new Porsche Club, with free customisation including special liveries and performance parts, alongside exclusive furniture, titles, namecards, phone wallpapers and cases. The collaboration extends beyond the driver’s seat, offering more ways for players to bring their enthusiasm for Porsche into their lives in Hethereau.

The partnership continues the first-ever automotive brand collaboration of its kind in the anime urban RPG genre, offering players the exhilarating experience of driving a world-class luxury sports car to explore NTE’s vibrant open world in style.

Players can also look forward to a range of gifts and rewards throughout Version 1.4:

items.title: NTE Steam Login FAQ
items.summary: Hey, Appraisers! On \[08/19/2026], NTE will be adding Steam account login support. If you're a new player, you can simply log in with Steam to jump right into the game. If you're an existing player with game progress and want to link that t
items.content:
Hey, Appraisers!

On \[08/19/2026], NTE will be adding Steam account login support. If you're a new player, you can simply log in with Steam to jump right into the game. If you're an existing player with game progress and want to link that to your Steam account, be sure to log in to NTE using your existing game account first, and then go to \ > \ to link your Steam account.

We've also put together a list of FAQs below for your reference. If you have any other questions, feel free to reach out to Customer Support at nte.contactus@perfectworld.com.

Q: I've already logged in to NTE using my Steam account. Can I still link another game account that already has progress?

A: No. Logging in with a Steam account automatically creates a brand-new User ID, and that Steam account can't be linked to another game account with existing progress.

Q: If I play on Steam with my Steam account, can I continue playing on other platforms?

A: Yes. After you link your Steam account to an email address in the User Center, you can use that email to log in on other platforms and keep your game progress synced.

Q: My Steam account is linked to an email address / Facebook / Google. Can I unlink them later?

A: You can unlink third-party login accounts like Facebook, Google, and Steam in the User Center. Email accounts cannot be unlinked. Please proceed with care.

Q: If I unlink a Steam account from my email account, which account keeps the game progress?

A: Once the unlinking is complete, your character progress will remain with your email account.

Q: Can I link a Steam account on mobile or other clients?

A: No. Currently, only the Steam game client supports Steam account login and linking.

Q: Can an unlinked Steam account be linked to a different game account?

A: Yes. Once unlinked, your Steam account returns to an unused state and is ready to be linked to another NTE game account that isn't already linked to Steam. The process still follows the same order: log in to the target game account first, then link Steam.

NTE will undergo version maintenance on August 19, 2026 from 06:00 to 11:00 (UTC+8). Once it's done, the all-new Version 1.3 "Rising from the Moonlit Fog" goes live. "Pink Paws Heist" will be temporarily unavailable starting August 19 at 05:30 (UTC+8) and will reopen once maintenance wraps up.

Login will be unavailable during this period, so please plan accordingly. Since this update is on the larger side, we recommend using Wi-Fi or mobile data to complete the download. We apologize for any inconvenience!

※ "The Lifeline" Limited Board ends on August 19, 2026, at 05:59 (UTC+8). Be sure to head to the Wayfarer Perks page and redeem your rewards before then.

\

● Duration: August 19, 2026, 06:00–11:00 (UTC+8)

● Maintenance Compensation: Annulith x300

● Eligibility: Appraisers who created their character before August 19, 2026, 06:00 (UTC+8)

● Distribution: Sent via in-game mail after maintenance. Remember to claim the items before they expire.

※Maintenance may end earlier or later than scheduled depending on actual progress. Please keep an eye on our official announcements for updates.

● Bug Fix Compensation: Annulith x300

● Eligibility: Appraisers who created their character before August 19, 2026, 06:00 (UTC+8)

Mac: Download or update from the App Store.

1. New Character & Arc

● New Limited S-Class Character: Zankou!

Available: August 19 (after update) – September 9, 05:59 (UTC+8)

Unlock Requirement: Complete the main story quest "Prologue - A New Destination - Head to Eibon Antique Shop"

Board Details: The "Alluring Shadows" Limited Board features the limited S-Class character Zankou, along with A-Class characters Mint, Edgar, and Adler.

During the event, the "Alluring Shadows" Limited Board features the "Scarlet Sash" glider livery, the "Sandy Mirage" Sirocco vehicle livery, and Zankou's "Autumn Vignette" outfit. The "Alluring Perks" event opens alongside the board, so you can claim these rewards directly from the event page once you reach 50/120/200 cumulative rolls, or obtain them randomly through rolls before reaching these milestones.

*For full details, head to Scarborough Fair in-game.

● New Limited S-Class Arc: "Ravenous Blade"

Available: August 19 (after update) – September 9, 05:59 (UTC+8)

Unlock Requirement: Complete the main story quest "Prologue - A New Destination - Head to Eibon Antique Shop"

Research Guide: Spend Tri-Keys or Spellbound Keys to participate in the "Spellbound Special" Arc Research Program and obtain the limited S-Class Arc "Ravenous Blade". This Arc is currently only available through this program.

*For full details, head to Arc Shop › Arc Research Program in-game.

● Returning Limited S-Class Character: Nanally!

Available: August 19 (after update) – September 9, 05:59 (UTC+8)

Unlock Requirement: Complete the main story quest "Prologue - A New Destination - Head to Eibon Antique Shop"

Board Details: "The Ichi-daime" Limited Board features the limited S-Class character Nanally, along with A-Class characters Mint, Edgar, and Adler.

items.title: NTE: Neverness to Everness Has Some Trouble On Steam Deck
items.summary: NTE: Neverness to Everness may be on Steam now, but it falls into the same performance issues on Steam Deck that most similar gacha games encounter.

I’m not sure why, but I’ve been on a gacha game kick lately. I got back into Wuthering Waves and found myself turning my AYN Odin 3 into a Gacha game machine. I downloaded Genshin Impact, Honkai Star Rail, Zenless Zone Zero, and a new one I’ve been playing more of, NTE: Neverness to Everness . It’s been a lot of fun to play, and it was perfect timing because the game just recently launched on Steam. With that in mind, I wanted to check it out and see how the game is running on the Steam Deck and how the experience compares to the standalone version that we can manually install via the game’s launcher.

For those who may not know, NTE: Neverness to Everness is a gacha game created by Hotta Studio. We run around in an urban open-world city, taking on missions, getting into flashy combat, and collecting new characters through its gacha systems. There’s a lot more to it that makes me think of GTA or Marvel’s Spider-Man world than we can get cars to drive around the city quickly or fast travel. It seems very F2P-friendly as well, with lots of unlockables for free and a lot of chances to get the characters we want. Just recently, with the 1.2 update, the team gave out a free character and about 2200 of their premium currency, which is just a treat.

However, performance on the Steam Deck isn’t always the greatest for these kinds of games. A lot of them are very CPU-heavy, which leads to a good chunk of stutters that can harm the experience. Almost every gacha game I’ve played has similar problems, and that includes NTE .

In contained fights, on the lowest possible settings, it can stick to 30 FPS for the most part, though it does stutter and drop here and there when a lot of flashy effects are on the screen. So, some combat scenarios are a bit worse than others. However, running around the city can cost some drops, and driving around is significantly worse. So, I would consider it somewhat playable for minor grinding, but it’s definitely going to have its issues when trying to get around without fast traveling or in large fights.

I also took some time to compare the Steam and Launcher versions of the game. Usually, Steam versions will have slightly better performance and fewer stutters due to the shared shader cache system on Steam. However, it is a fairly new release, so the cache isn’t there yet. Because of this, performance is relatively the same, with the Steam version performing slightly worse. As we can see in the visual below, I tested both games with the same “Smooth” preset on the Fourth Stop of the Gloaming Circle Ghost Train with the same exact characters, and the results are pretty similar to each other.

Ultimately, it’s possible that within the next week, we will see the shader cache appear, and performance will get better, especially when it comes to stutters. However, it’s still going to need those compromises, including lower settings and a 30 FPS cap for stability, and we probably will still have some CPU bottlenecks that result in other stutters, especially when driving around. I do see some possibilities to play on the Steam Deck this way for some of its content, but it’s not something that’ll be stable throughout the entire game.

NTE: Neverness to Everness is currently free to play on Steam right now.
